import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 324, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "2": {"demand": 38, "setup_cost": 283, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "3": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 112, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},

    "6": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 381, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "7": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 382, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "8": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 457, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "9": {"demand": 31, "setup_cost": 492, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "10": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 263, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "11": {"demand": 19, "setup_cost": 407, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "12": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 389, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "13": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 324, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "14": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 401, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "15": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 324, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "16": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 339, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "17": {"demand": 31, "setup_cost": 113, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "18": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 132, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "19": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 480, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "20": {"demand": 16, "setup_cost": 123, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "21": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 142, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "22": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 178, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "23": {"demand": 11, "setup_cost": 190, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "24": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 427, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "25": {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 378, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 50, "2": 44, "3": 36, "4": 39, "5": 15, "6": 38, "7": 13, "8": 20,
    "9": 25, "10": 15, "11": 21, "12": 42, "13": 18, "14": 45, "15": 25,
    "16": 58, "17": 25, "18": 40, "19": 17, "20": 21, "21": 11, "22": 21,
    "23": 10, "24": 12, "25": 36
}

# Erstelle das Modell
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere Gesamtkosten
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfragebedingung
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbedingung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Ausgabe der Ergebnisse
result = {
    "production": {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

print(json.dumps(result))
